summary: Backend-only testing of PromptCut. Full lifecycle covered: create project, upload sample video, Whisper transcription, Claude Sonnet 4.5 chat producing edit_plan, persisted messages/edit_plan, ffmpeg render with 9:16 + captions + 2s trim, output serving as video/mp4, list projects, and error 404 paths. All 13 pytest cases passed (100%).

minor.issue: response_model=Project but route accepts arbitrary dict body; 422 not raised for malformed payloads. Acceptable per spec (no auth, demo-grade).
If captions enabled and an SRT file path contains apostrophes or unusual chars, ffmpeg subtitles filter could fail. Sample path is safe; flag for future hardening.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: response_model=Project on POST /api/projects but body is dict[str, Any] | None — consider Pydantic CreateProjectRequest for validation.
transcribe endpoint runs synchronously inside the request (long-running). For real videos this will hit timeouts; consider background task + status polling (transcript_status already exists).
render endpoint also blocks; same recommendation — kick off async job and poll render_status.
render_service: subtitles file path is escaped only for ':'; other special chars in path could break the filter. Use a fixed safe filename or quoted path properly.
llm_service._extract_plan uses non-greedy regex on the first JSON-looking block; nested braces in any text would break it. Worked for current model output but is fragile.
No size limit on upload (UploadFile). For production add max body size and content-type validation.
chat endpoint stores message even if LLM call later fails — user_doc inserted before try/except. Acceptable but leaves orphan user message; consider deletion on failure.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 'Test' project + 1 'TEST_no_render' project + uploaded/transcribed/rendered the sample.mp4 during the run. Storage left in /app/backend/storage/<project_id>/.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_promptcut_api.py and cover the entire request flow including real Claude + Whisper + ffmpeg calls. Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_promptcut_api.py -v`. Sample asset at /tmp/sample.mp4 (8s, sine audio). EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in /app/backend/.env.
